text_block_list.text: We've gotta practice for interviews while we still have time! Trainer!

text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's practice lots so we don't get nervous~!

text_block_list.text:

I'm just trying to pump you up!

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.text:

Trying hard is what I'm best at, after all♪
